notes.title: Playtest Day!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We are super excited for today! We have a limited playtest today at 6pm CST and would love for you to join us and give us feedback! We are working tirelessly to provide a great game for everyone to enjoy! We will have some developers in the discord at that time and we would love to hangout and chat with you all and hear your thoughts!
Discord: https://discord.gg/dCWEu3pFEM

We have also granted 100 play testers access to our game currently, and have the tutorial available for play. We understand it may not be the best tutorial, and plan on updating that as we go. Thank you for your patience!

If at any point you find an issue or bug please report it here so that we can take a look and fix it in a timely manner!
Bug Report:  https://forms.gle/fLiSSxsQLXU3my186

notes.title: FreakShow Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Outcasts!
We are very excited to release FreakShow and have you all try it out!
This project has been worked on for over 2 years and we would love to hear your feedback!

We are hosting a public playtest [b]May 23 @ 6pm-8pm CST[/b]. 
If you can make it we would love for you to be able to join us!

Please [b]sign up[/b] here: https://forms.gle/bDPEAWmAZe1n83Qo9

Join our discord to hangout and get some unique updates:  https://discord.gg/dCWEu3pFEM


See you in the Arena!
-FreakShow Dev Team
